data.one_liner: Flutter package providing Laravel-inspired form validation rules as declarative validators
data.what_it_does: It exposes a set of validation rules that can be applied to TextFormField validators via a simple syntax. Rules can be supplied as strings or FLValidator objects and support custom messages and attribute labels.
use_when: You need quick, readable validation logic without writing custom validator functions
You prefer Laravel-like rule syntax in Flutter forms
You want to reuse validation rules across multiple fields
avoid_when: You require complex asynchronous validation that depends on external services
You need highly customized error handling beyond simple messages
strengths: Supports custom messages and attribute labels
No code generation or build steps required
weaknesses: No support for async or remote validation
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package
